summary: Tested new Purchasing Plan feature (router nav highlighting, generate/regenerate flow, stat cards, missing-BOMs collapsible warning, empty state) and did a regression smoke-check on the BOM Explorer page after the router refactor. All tested flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: NavTabs.jsx correctly uses useLocation() with exact pathname match - verified bg-white/20 highlighting toggles correctly between '/' and '/purchasing-plan', bug from previous session is fixed.
purchasing_plan.py _collect_leaves correctly skips sub-assemblies (nodes with children) and only aggregates true leaf quantities - matches the described requirement.

Months are computed dynamically via _next_n_months(date.today()) - verified live result showed 'Sep 2026 & Oct 2026' which is next 2 sequential months relative to current server date (Feb 2026 test context aside, server clock returned Aug 2026 as 'today' -> Sep/Oct next 2 months), consistent and sequential as expected.

Observation (not necessarily a bug, flagging for awareness): in the live generated plan, ALL component 'Oct 2026 Qty'/'Value' columns showed exactly 0 while Sep 2026 had real figures - could be a genuine OMS data gap (no forecast rows yet for month 2) or could indicate get_monthly_demand/month iteration issue worth a quick sanity check by main agent since it means the current live plan is effectively single-month in practice.

success_rate.backend: 100% (verified indirectly via UI, live pipeline returned 44 components + 59 missing_boms consistent with main agent's smoke test)
